subject: Request: chain-of-custody and log deletion evidence for Meridian deployment
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <a.khan@meridianhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: security@meridianhealth.com
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request — chain-of-custody for connector logs (Meridian)

Hi Logan,

We're working through our internal audit for our Redwood deployment and need to validate a few items related to connector and agent logs persisted to Redwood's hosted pipeline. Specifically: 

- Chain-of-custody evidence for logs written between 2026-09-20 and 2026-09-25 (inclusive). We need hash manifests and any transfer logs showing who/what moved the files.
- Confirmation of the deletion process for logs purged after 30 days; we need the deletion step sequence and timing (e.g., when was the object tombstoned, when was it removed from backups).
- Any signed attestation Redwood can provide for the above items we can include in our audit binder.

Can you confirm what artifacts you can provide and an ETA? We may need an expedited pack for our auditor by EOD Wednesday (2026-10-13).

Thanks — appreciate the help.

Aisha Khan
Senior Security Manager, Meridian Health
security@meridianhealth.com

(Attachment: example_request_template.xlsx)

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <a.khan@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — chain-of-custody for connector logs (Meridian)

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marissa from Trust & Security and Jonas from Forensics to prepare the pack. Quick answers up front:

- We can produce a SHA256 manifest for the object set, an S3-like object manifest with timestamps, and a transfer/audit log showing which service account performed the upload.
- Deletion pipeline: tombstone (deletion marker) -> async lifecycle job -> eventual object removal -> background reindex/expunge from replicas. We will provide the exact timestamps where available.
- We can provide a signed attestation; Marissa will propose wording and Jonas will include technical artifacts.

Can you confirm whether the artifacts need to be redacted (PHI/PII) and whether your legal team requires individual file-level hashes or a pack-level signed manifest. Also confirm the auditor deadline (you mentioned EOD Wed 10/13 — is that midnight PT or close of business CT?).

I'll coordinate delivery and advise on what will be in the zip.

—Logan
Logan Wright
Manager, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com

(Attachment: custody-request-ack.txt)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <a.khan@meridianhealth.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — chain-of-custody for connector logs (Meridian)

Hi Aisha — thanks, we can assemble the following deliverables and hit your Wednesday deadline if there are no additional redaction constraints: 

Deliverables we will provide (ETA: Wed 2026-10-13, 14:00 PT):
- log-hash-manifest.csv — row per object: object_key, created_at, uploaded_by, sha256, size_bytes
- s3-transfer-audit.log (snippet) — timestamped events showing PUT/COPY/DELETE with service account ids
- deletion-sequence.md — plain-language timeline of the deletion pipeline and timestamps for deleted objects in the requested date range
- custody-attestation-draft.pdf — signed PDF attestation template we can sign once you confirm wording
- redwood-soc2-export.zip — archival export of event logs and metadata for the window (redacted per your guidance)

Notes and assumptions:
- We currently retain 90 days of immutable transfer logs and 30 days of hot object storage for connector payloads by default. The objects you asked about fall in the 30-day deletion window — we still have transfer logs for them.
- If you require file-level attestation for PHI-containing files, we will need to coordinate limited redaction or provide a redacted manifest; please advise.
- We will include a signed hash manifest and a pack-level signed cert (timestamped) to satisfy chain-of-custody evidence.

If Meridian legal prefers DocuSign for attestation, send the contact and we will initiate.

Marissa Cole
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

(Attachments mentioned: log-hash-manifest.csv (sample), deletion-sequence.md)

Thanks Marissa — that sounds good and should meet the auditor's needs. Two quick clarifications before you finalize the pack:

   - connector/meridian/2026-09-21/ingest.log.gz

Please include file-level hash rows for these two objects.

Also confirm whether the deletion-sequence.md will include the timestamp when objects were removed from backups/replicas (our auditor requires explicit backup purge statements).

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

—Aisha
